changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillinginvoice AS SELECT bi.id, bi.invoice_number, bi.patient_id, bi.facility_id, bi.status, bi.total_amount, bi.paid_amount, bi.balance_amount, bi.currency, bi.created_by, bi.created_date, bi.last_modified_by, bi.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_invoice bi;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillinginvoice TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillinginvoice FROM report_user;
